whole_paper_comparison: sum complete source manuscripts / (complete U_D + complete D1+D2+D3), with source corrections/exclusions explicit. No hidden exclusion of unused Normalizer or context.
conditional: Complete source / complete application after acquiring whole U_D and the complete declared eight-program boundary.

programs.printed_representation: Complete12-page appendix counted once, including all8 programs, wrapper, headings and comments.
programs.raw_representation: All8 complete raw programs alternate to printed representation, never additional.
programs.driver_policy: Complete raw driver counts are separately inventoried and not added to paper/program ratios.
programs.logical_policy: Only the5 required programs have proof-use routes. Diagnostics retain positively measured printed owners and validation-only routes; drivers remain operational-only.

owner_policy: One owner per extracted codepoint. Tokens/runs belong to their first-character owner after normalization. Shared node interfaces and parent branches use unions of owner IDs. Repeated physically printed statements retain every span. All raw furniture has explicit owners.
scope_policy: The already accepted logical graph fixes proof routes. Exclusive spans need not match overlapping exact proof locators. Context, references and unused auxiliary statements remain in full-paper costs.

atomic_allocator_ancestry.scope: Reuse the accepted C/B allocation algorithm; no new metric or source font map.

font_calibration: Use the exact accepted D v2 occurrence/event mapping. No calibration edit or copied C font mapping.
